descriptions.zh: 本接口用于获取指定产品id、指定环境影响（methodType）、指定分组汇总级别（group）、指定计算方式下（emissionType）的排放的降序列表。可用于了解多种环境影响排放情况。
descriptions.en: This API retrieves a descending list of emissions for a specified product ID, environmental impact (methodType), grouping level (group), and calculation method (emissionType). You can use this API to understand the emissions associated with various environmental impacts.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun energyexpertexternal get-inventory-list --code C-20080808-1 --product-id 1024 --product-type 1 --method-type gwp --emission-type footprint --group resource --region cn-hangzhou
